meta.title: Only a valid surrogate bidder may place one

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a bid on a vendor's behalf (surrogate bid) for the invited QA vendor.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Cannot place bid on trade by your own company”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: Only a valid surrogate bidder may place one

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)

expected.message: Cannot place bid on trade by your own company
